distinguishing_features: A physical hydraulic tuned-mass damper generates a counteracting damping force from an oscillating coolant column rather than predicting instability from oil temperature/viscosity.
The damper is integrated into the spindle's existing coolant supply/return loop using an isolated reservoir, orifice/accumulator, and diversion valve.
The damper is tuned to the spindle/chatter structural mode to reduce cutting-edge vibration amplitude below the stability boundary.
Spindle load current and tool/machine data are used to trigger or adapt the damper circuit.
